name: grave-orthros-tape-gold
what: Whole-tape hymn boundaries for Grave mode Orthros, cut by ear by the chanter.
structure: Every melos hymn is immediately preceded by its own parallagi. Verified: 23 parallagi / 23 melos, strict alternation, no orphan of either kind. This is a hard structural prior for the corpus, not a coincidence of this tape.
caveats: The doxology melos (last span) is cut off after "εκπισαμεν επι σε" -- it did not fit on the 60-minute tape. Its parallagi IS complete, so the pair is usable for parallagi-side work but the melos must not be treated as a whole hymn.

One hymn near the middle was interrupted by the tape flip and then restarted. Only the complete replay from the second 30-minute half is marked; the truncated first attempt is deliberately outside every span.
A stretch where Vasilikos is talking about a hymn is deliberately outside every span. Material not covered by a span is excluded on purpose, never by oversight.
The first span (61.26-107.08) has no lane set and is not part of any parallagi/melos pair; it needs a label before this tape is fully closed.

measured_against_pipeline.note: The pipeline cuts in hymns.json for this tape, scored by IoU against the 23 gold melos spans.
measured_against_pipeline.failure_mode: over-splitting: t21/t22/t23 are all one gold melos span, as are t54/t55/t57 and t05/t06 and t33/t34
